title: Projective space over Z represents invertible modules with generating sections
statement: Let $n\ge0$, let $\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}=\operatorname{Proj}(\mathbf Z[T_0,\dots,T_n])$ with $\deg T_i=1$, and let $\mathcal O(1)$ be its twisting sheaf, with the global sections $T_0,\dots,T_n$. For a scheme $Y$, consider pairs $(\mathcal L,(s_0,\dots,s_n))$ of an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module $\mathcal L$ [def-sc-invertible-module] and global sections $s_0,\dots,s_n\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L)$ that generate $\mathcal L$ (for every $y\in Y$ some $s_i$ has nonzero image in $\mathcal L_y\otimes\kappa(y)$), up to the equivalence $(\mathcal L,(s_i))\sim(\mathcal N,(t_i))$ iff there is an isomorphism $\beta:\mathcal L\to\mathcal N$ with $\beta(s_i)=t_i$ for all $i$. Then for every such pair there is a unique morphism $\psi_{(\mathcal L,(s_i))}:Y\to\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ with an isomorphism $\psi^*\mathcal O(1)\cong\mathcal L$ carrying $\psi^*T_i$ to $s_i$ for all $i$; equivalent pairs give the same morphism, every morphism $Y\to\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ arises in this way, and the construction is compatible with pullback along morphisms $Y'\to Y$. That is, $\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ represents the functor $Y\mapsto\{(\mathcal L,(s_0,\dots,s_n))\}/\sim$ [def-pc-representable-functor].

source.place: Constructions, Lemma 27.13.1 (Tag 01NE, label lemma-projective-space), proved there as the special case of Lemma 01NA (label lemma-apply), itself a reformulation of Lemma 01N9 (label lemma-proj-functor-strict)
